name: phase:ideas
description: An idea for later (with enhancement and later)

name: phase:building
description: A Developer is building it (build phase only), or the UX Designer for ux work (any time)

name: phase:ready-for-qa
description: Pull request open with Fixes #n; waits for QA (lifecycle step 3)

name: phase:in-qa
description: The QA Engineer reviews the exact commit (QA phase only)

name: phase:qa-failed
description: QA failed; recommended changes in the verdict comment

name: phase:fixing
description: The Defect-fix Developer is fixing it (QA phase only); returns to phase:in-qa with an explanation

name: phase:qa-passed
description: QA passed the latest commit; it is merged, released and deployed now

name: phase:delivered
description: Merged, released and deployed (each shown as its own status)

name: phase:owner-qa
description: The owner's follow-up look; never blocks merge, release or deploy

name: ux
description: Interface and style work by the UX Designer; may be built at any time

name: ux-queued
description: A UX pull request that waits until the Developer finishes the current task

name: owner-override
description: The owner allowed this item outside the team phase

name: agent:claude
description: The current actor is a Claude agent

name: agent:codex
description: The current actor is a Codex agent
